description:
In this video, I share my personal Top 5 Health Insurance Companies in India based on 12+years of experience in insurance consulting, claim handling of more than16,000 claims, and customer feedback. ℹ️

Please understand that these are my preferred companies, but that does not mean they will be the best choice for everyone. Health insurance selection always depends on medical eligibility, financial capacity, and long-term sustainability.💡

Below are the companies and the reasons why I consider them among the best.

1. New India Assurance Company
One of the most reliable PSU insurance companies with:
✔ Smooth claim experience
✔ Strong Incurred Claim Ratio (ICR) and Claim Settlement Ratio (CSR)
✔ Quick communication and support

However, the company does have certain restrictions and coverage limits, which customers should carefully understand before buying.

2. Bajaj Allianz General Insurance
Chosen because of:
✔ Strong solvency margin
✔ Large market share
✔ Proven claim experience
However, premiums at higher ages can be expensive, so this company is generally more suitable for HNI (High Net Worth Individual) clients.

3. HDFC ERGO General Insurance
Recommended due to:
✔ Strong systems and underwriting process
✔ Reliable reinsurance backing
✔ Excellent claim track record
This plan is often ideal for individuals with stable income and long-term planning mindset. Health insurance should always be considered a long-term financial protection, because once medical history develops, portability to another insurer becomes extremely difficult.

4. ICICI Lombard General Insurance
Strengths include:
✔ Clear communication
✔ Strong operational systems
✔ Excellent claim support
✔ Fast discharge process for customers with ₹15 lakh+ sum insured
However, we have stopped recommending this company for now due to a specific policy clause called “Material Change.”
This clause allows the insurer to modify coverage scope or premiums during renewal based on new medical history. Since this condition still exists in the policy wording, we believe customers should carefully review it before choosing this insurer.

5. Tata AIG General Insurance – Medicare Premier
My personal health insurance policy.
Reasons:
✔ One of the finest health insurance options available
✔ Minimal restrictive terms & conditions
✔ Extended coverage benefits
However, policy acceptance can be strict, as underwriting standards are quite detailed.

Important Reminder 🗣️
Always declare every medical history honestly while applying and don’t forget to ask what is not covered. Hidden T&c 
Also remember:
✔ My favourite health insurance company may not be the right one for you
✔ Some customers need special coverage (example: newborn complications coverage)
✔ Some people at higher ages or with health issues may require completely different insurers
The best health insurance depends on:
• Medical eligibility
• Financial capacity
• Long-term affordability
• Family health history
